response.sql: SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS analysed_trade_records, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind ORDER BY t.tradekind;
